profile: Caribou Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing genome-edited cell therapies. Its chRDNA technology is used to engineer allogeneic, or off-the-shelf, CAR-T cell therapy candidates made from healthy donor cells. The company is advancing candidates targeting CD19 for B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma and BCMA for multiple myeloma. These investigational therapies are intended for patients with hematologic malignancies and are being evaluated in clinical trials.
